title: The 2024 ADA Web Accessibility Rule Still Stands — So Why Is Everyone Suddenly on Edge?
summary: The 2024 ADA Title II web accessibility rule for state and local government websites and mobile apps remains fully in force; WCAG 2.1 Level AA is still the operative standard and compliance deadlines have not changed, though the DOJ has shifted to a faster interim-final-rule process, causing concern among advocates.
body:
The 2024 ADA Title II web accessibility rule for state and local government websites and mobile apps remains fully in force; WCAG 2.1 Level AA is still the operative standard and compliance deadlines have not changed, though the DOJ has shifted to a faster interim-final-rule process, causing concern among advocates.
